comment: Spots each tapped hole to its thread's major diameter (a 90 degree chamfer at the thread's entry) with the smallest spot drill that makes it. Starter template generated by tools/gen_library.py (task T-057): rules and numbers chosen by that script as conservative generic starting points, not copied from any table; compare with Machinery's Handbook (Industrial Press), 'Drilling' and 'Tapping'. Check them against your machine, tools and material before relying on them.
